{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows early negative momentum.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-8%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment turns positive after 3-5 days, adjust upward by 2-5%.",
    "For long-term horizons (>14 days), reduce forecast volatility by 15-20% to avoid overreaction to short-term noise.",
    "When sentiment is neutral or mildly positive, apply a slight upward bias (1-3%) to capture potential rebound.",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent low prices: if true outcome is below 5% of 30-day moving average, reduce forecast by 2-5%."
  ]
}
